_doc: Configuration for checks/check.mjs. denylist: retired facts that may never return in any scanned text file, add the OLD wording whenever a fact changes (see AGENTS.md conflict rule). Each entry: pattern (JS regex source, case-insensitive), why (shown on failure), optional exclude (path substrings to skip). docs/decisions/, archives and checks/ are never scanned by the denylist (decision records may quote retired wording). styleBans: AI-boilerplate phrases banned in all text (prose-style check, decision 0008); same shape as denylist, seeded with tells measured to fire on no legitimate prose, extend per project. The prose-style check also bans AI typography (em dash, en dash, ellipsis and curly quotes) with no config needed; escape a deliberate case with checks:allow-style on the line. commentBans: the deferral-apology set, the negative image of the defer: contract - scanned by defer-markers on comment lines in code files only, because 'for now' is legitimate in a string or a UI label and only a comment can apologise for a simplification. thirdParty: paths this project did not write, each { path, why }: an installed methodology, a vendored SDK. The gates that measure this project's own writing (prose style, denylist, agent-file cap, code-file cap, the deferral contract, zombie code, the skills registry, the document map) skip them; every other gate, secrets included, still applies. Matching is by path prefix, so an upstream rename inside the payload changes nothing here. extraTextExtensions/extraCodeExtensions: the stack skill adds this ecosystem's file types here. codeFileCapExclude: path prefixes/suffixes that hold generated or vendored code, skipped by code-file-cap and commentBans, since neither this project's length budget nor its deferral contract governs code it did not write; a comment in the file that opens with checks:allow-length: <reason> works too for the length cap, while a mention of that marker in prose or inside a string does not, because the exemption is a declaration a file makes about itself. Exclusion lists are themselves gated by config-invariants: none of them may hide docs/standards/, and only secretScanExclude may name checks/. skipSymlinkCheck: false, or the reason as a string on a checkout without symlink support (Windows without Developer Mode) - config-invariants rejects a bare true, because retiring a whole check states its case like every other exemption here.

denylist.why: retired manifest wording; the decision-record note no longer carries a number range (it went stale at 0009)
retired explainer heading counts; headings stay numberless, the hero stat strip owns live counts (drifted once: heading said 14 while check.mjs had 17)
retired stat-strip count: 15 recorded decisions exist since 0015; bump the strip when a decision lands, until the counts are derived (GAP Phase 3)
wrong EAA date that once stood in the register: pre-2025 service contracts run until 2030-06-28 at the latest (EAA Art 32(2), verified 2026-07-22), no EU/NL deadline exists on 2027-06-28
retired NIS2 register wording; the Cyberbeveiligingswet is in force 2026-08-15, the register row owns the current status
retired AI Act citation; the omnibus is Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force 2026-07-27, and the register row owns the current citation
retired AI Act register wording; the omnibus is no longer pending publication and the register row owns the current citation

denylist.pattern: ensure that the people operating them have a level of AI literacy
denylist.why: retired AI Act Art 4 wording; the Digital Omnibus softened it to taking measures that support AI literacy, with no level to guarantee in any individual (AI-LITERACY.md owns the current statement). Pre-omnibus training data says otherwise, so this one returns by itself
retired 0001 claim; since agent-file-cap the scheme is two-tier: working budget 150 for AGENTS.md, hard cap 200 for every agent rulebook file
retired ingest snippets; install/CLI/API syntax is read from the markitdown README at use time (skill-author: no code snippets that go stale)

denylist.pattern: Groundwork is itself software placed on the EU market
denylist.why: retired brief claim; unmonetised free and open-source software sits outside both the CRA (Art 2(1) with recital 18) and the PLD (Art 2(2)), verified 2026-07-31. REGISTER.md rows C-1 to C-4 own the current answer, and monetising is what would change it
wrong licence for the inlined icon set: Lucide is ISC and descends from Feather (MIT), and index.html now names both
retired instruction; skipSymlinkCheck takes the reason as a string value and config-invariants rejects a bare true, so an exemption states its case (INTAKE row 58)
retired pointer; COMPLIANCE.md is one table of regimes with no numbered sections, and this project's register moved to docs/compliance/REGISTER.md, which begin copies from TEMPLATE-REGISTER.md
retired begin instruction; the register is a cp from docs/compliance/TEMPLATE-REGISTER.md now, like the brief, the deploy runbook and the debt ledger

denylist.pattern: definitions cover language|no implementation detail in this file
denylist.why: retired glossary rule; a CONTEXT.md entry may now settle how a term is measured (which period, which basis, who counts) and stops at the threshold value and the branching, which belong in a spec where a test can execute them (decision 0019)

retired taste-skill machinery; a page is no longer configured by three numeric knobs set before the owner sees anything. The installed design method commits a direction contract, a color strategy and one authored motion instead (decision 0020)
retired upstream pointer; the frontend rulebook this repo adapted from it is gone and the installed design method owns that ground now (decision 0020 supersedes 0012)

retired path; the design system is docs/DESIGN.md since 2026-08-07, beside docs/PRODUCT.md, because that is where the installed design method reads both without configuration (decision 0020). docs/design/ still owns VOICE.md and reference/
retired skill; taste was removed on 2026-08-07 and nothing may point at it again. What each of its rules became is the table in decision 0020

chat residue: boilerplate enthusiasm aimed at a conversation partner
chat residue: an answer opener, not a sentence in a document
chat residue: agreement addressed to a person, not content
chat residue: the model's own limits are not a fact about this project
citation artifact pasted from an assistant's output; keep the source, drop the marker
search-tool citation artifact; cite the real URL instead
tracking parameter from an assistant's link; paste the clean URL
citation artifact pasted from an assistant's output; keep the source, drop the marker
unresolved claim: verify it and cite the source, or delete the claim
closing summary that restates what was just said; end on the last real point
AI-tell flourish; say what it shows
ornamental noun; name the thing and its number
unfalsifiable superlative; state the version or the measurement
hype verb; describe the actual change
hype verb for a feature list; say 'has', or state the number
landing-page filler that addresses everyone and no one; name the actual user
empty run-up; start the sentence at the point

commentBans.why: an unmarked deferral rots silently; use the defer: marker with its ceiling and upgrade-when trigger
a simplification the reader cannot audit; use the defer: marker so it stays grep-recoverable
code that admits it is not the real thing; either build it or mark it with defer:
tutorial phrasing in shipped code; finish it or mark it with defer:
advice to an imaginary reader instead of a decision; state what this code does, or defer: it

thirdParty.why: impeccable, the design methodology this project builds interfaces with (Apache-2.0), installed per project at its current release and gitignored like a dependency. This repo's house style governs what this repo writes; measuring somebody else's payload would force a patch on every upstream release, which is what makes "always the current version" impossible (spec 011). Every gate that is not about our own writing still applies to it.
